description: This file defines an abstract C# class `GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner` for testing transaction fault handling in Orleans grains, including methods for aborting transactions on exceptions, read-only violations, and orphan calls, with utilities to verify state after operations.

classes.name: GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test methods for handling transaction faults in Orleans grains.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests that a transaction is aborted when an exception occurs during adding grains.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnReadOnlyViolatedException
methods.description: Tests that a transaction is aborted when a read-only violation exception occurs.

methods.name: MultiGrainAbortTransactionOnExceptions
methods.description: Tests transactional abort behavior across multiple grains when one throws an exception.

methods.name: AbortTransactionExceptionInnerExceptionOnlyContainsOneRootCauseException
methods.description: Checks that inner exceptions during transaction abort contain only the root cause exception.

methods.name: AbortTransactionOnOrphanCalls
methods.description: Tests that orphaned calls cause transaction aborts.

methods.name: TestAfterDustSettles
methods.description: Utility method that retries a test action to account for eventual consistency after transaction dust settles.
